replit_md_opening:
# Futures in Focus (FiF) - Futures Literacy Platform

**Version 0.9** - Release Candidate

An AI-powered platform for understanding 10 civilization-level transformations reshaping humanity. Features multi-modal conversation with a Futures Navigator AI, transformation domain archive, structured learning journeys, scenario planning, and comprehensive user expertise tracking.

**Branding**: "F·U·T·U·R·E·S in Focus" (styled with middle dot separators). Alternative short name: "FiF"

**Logo**: Colorful watercolor infinity symbol representing continuous futures exploration (stored at `attached_assets/fif-logo.png`)
tagline_note: FUTURES_SPEC.md uses the spec tagline. The English UI string in translations.ts is a two-line splash line, stored in source as a \n escape.
